output.note: Recomputes share-rate conversions for a rebasing liquid-staking token from caller-declared state: internal ether (the rate numerator), internal shares (the rate denominator) and external shares. Conversions use internal ether and internal shares, rounded down; total shares, external ether and total pooled ether are reported as disclosure only. This kernel does NOT read any chain: it cannot know whether the declared values match any deployed token, whether a declared snapshot came from a real oracle report, or how external shares were minted. Fee rates, withdrawal finalization and mintable-external capacity are not modeled; fees enter only as a declared count of shares minted as fees. Findings are properties of the declared numbers under the stated arithmetic, not an audit of any deployment.

disclosed_totals.label: disclosure only; conversions use internal_ether and internal_shares
